_note: Retrieval-only A/B for TWIN_MEMORY_AGENTIC_RERANK, measured with bench-retrieval (same seeding + metrics as suiteRetrieval in harness.mjs, extraction suite skipped). Embeddings OFF (no OPENAI_API_KEY), so semanticScore is 0 throughout and the lexical gate carries the whole candidate set. results.json records the shipped default, which is this file's `gate-only` row.
readings: precisionAt5 always divides by 5, so abstention reads as a precision loss there; precisionOverReturned divides by what the twin actually saw and is the number that governs prompt noise.
Sonnet 5 is the only config that abstains reliably; Haiku ranks better on queries that do have an answer. Both are far above gate-only.
Rerank is off by default: it adds 1.5-3.8s ahead of the twin's first token.
